pattern.title: Use of the METS file section.

rule.assert: CSIP59;ERROR;An xml:id identifier for the file section used for internal package references.
CSIP60;ERROR;All documentation pertaining to the transferred content is placed in one or more file group elements with mets/fileSec/fileGrp/@USE attribute value “Documentation”.
CSIP113;ERROR;All XML schemas used in the information package should be referenced from one or more file groups with mets/fileSec/fileGrp/@USE attribute value “Schemas”.

CSIP114;ERROR;A pointer to the METS document describing the representation or pointers to the content being transferred must be present in one or more file groups with mets/fileSec/fileGrp/@USE attribute value “Representations”.

assert.test: every $admid_part in tokenize(@ADMID, '\s+') satisfies some $id in /mets:mets/mets:amdSec/*/@ID satisfies $admid_part = $id

rule.assert: CSIP61;ERROR;ADMID must contains real administrative metadata section ID.

CSIP62;ERROR;When the file group describes a representation with the `mets/fileSec/fileGrp/@USE` attribute value is starting with "Representations", then `mets/fileSec/fileGrp/@CONTENTINFORMATIONTYPE` must state the content information type specification used for the representation.
CSIP62;ERROR;When @csip:CONTENTINFORMATIONTYPE exists, it must have value from Vocabulary Content Information Type Specification.
CSIP63;ERROR;This attribute is mandatory when the mets/fileSec/fileGrp/@USE attribute value is “Representations”.
CSIP64;ERROR;This attribute is mandatory.
CSIP65;ERROR;This attribute is mandatory. An xml:id identifier for the file group used for internal package references. It must be unique within the package.
CSIP66;ERROR;The file group contains the file elements which describe the file objects.
CSIP67;ERROR;This attribute is mandatory. An xml:id identifier for the file group used for internal package references. It must be unique within the package.
CSIP68;ERROR;MUST record the MIME type of the referenced file.
CSIP69;ERROR;MUST record the size in bytes of the referenced file.
CSIP70;ERROR;MUST record the date the referenced file was created.
CSIP71;ERROR;MUST record the checksum of the referenced file.
CSIP72;ERROR;MUST record the checksum type of the referenced file.
rule.report: CSIP73;INFO;A file element has an OWNERID attribute.

assert.test: every $admid_part in tokenize(@ADMID, '\s+') satisfies some $id in /mets:mets/mets:amdSec/*/@ID satisfies $admid_part = $id

rule.assert: CSIP74;ERROR;ADMID must contains real administrative metadata section ID.
rule.report: CSIP75;INFO;A file element has an DMDID attribute.
rule.assert: CSIP76;ERROR;The location of each external file must be defined by the file location FLocat element.
CSIP77;ERROR;Mandatory, locator type is always used with the value “URL” from the vocabulary in the attribute.
CSIP78;ERROR;Attribute MUST be used with the value “simple”. Value list is maintained by the xlink standard.
CSIP79;ERROR;MUST record the actual location of the resource. This specification recommends recording a URL type filepath within this attribute.
